title: Oleic acid attenuates asthma pathogenesis via Th1/Th2 immune cell modulation, TLR3/4-NF-kappaB-related inflammation suppression, and intrinsic apoptotic pathway induction.
authors: Lee, Soon-Young; Le, Duc Dat; Bae, Chun-Sik; Park, Jin Woo; Lee, Mina; Cho, Seung-Sik; Park, Dae-Hun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究油酸对哮喘的免疫调节与抗炎作用，仅含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: WHO reported that asthma was responsible for 455,000 deaths in 2019 and asthma patients was evaluated 262 million in May 2023. The incidence is expected to increase as the average life expectancy increases, highlighting asthma as a significant health challenge in an aging society. The etiology of asthma is linked to an imbalance of Th1 and Th2 cells, respiratory inflammation, and pulmonary cell proliferation. The purpose of this study is to investigate the anti-asthmatic effect and potential mechanism of oleic acid. The anti-inflammatory effect of oleic acid was evaluated in an LPS-induced RAW 264.7 cell model, and immune modulation and the anti-apoptotic effect were measured in an ovalbumin-induced BALB/c mouse model. A variety of analytical procedures, such as MTT, qPCR, ELISA, Western blotting, immunofluorescence, gene transfection, immunohistochemistry, and several staining methods (Diff Quik, H&E, PAS), were used to evaluate the effectiveness and mechanisms of these methods. The results from in vitro experiments showed that oleic acid could reduce the levels of inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta), and molecular docking studies suggested that oleic acid could interact with TLR3 and TLR4 proteins to form ligand-protein complexes, showing good binding affinity. Additionally, oleic acid attenuated the expression of MAPK pathway components (JNK, p38 MAPK) and NF-kappaB pathway constituents (IkappaB, NF-kappaB, COX-2, PGE(2)). In vivo results indicated that oleic acid reduced the levels of inflammatory cells (WBCs and eosinophils) and IgE activity, reduced the expression of the Th2 cell transcription factor GATA-3, and decreased the levels of Th2/Th17-related cytokines (IL-4, TNF-alpha, and IL-6). Oleic acid also alleviated OVA-induced pathological changes in the lung, such as epithelial cell proliferation, inflammatory cell infiltration, and mucus hypersecretion. OVA restored apoptosis in lung epithelial cells by modulating the expression of Bcl-2 and Bax. In summary, oleic acid has potential as a novel candidate for asthma treatment through its ability to regulate immune cells, exert anti-inflammatory effects, and promote apoptosis, thereby ameliorating asthma manifestations.
abstract_zh: WHO报告称，2019年哮喘导致455,000人死亡，截至2023年5月，哮喘患者估计为262百万。随着平均寿命的增加，哮喘发病率预计将上升，凸显出哮喘在老龄化社会中作为重大健康挑战的地位。哮喘的病因与Th1和Th2细胞失衡、呼吸道炎症以及肺细胞增殖有关。本研究旨在探讨油酸（oleic acid）的抗哮喘作用及其潜在机制。在LPS诱导的RAW 264.7细胞模型中评估了油酸的抗炎作用，并在卵清蛋白（ovalbumin）诱导的BALB/c小鼠模型中测量了免疫调节和抗凋亡效应。采用多种分析程序，如MTT、qPCR、ELISA、Western blotting、免疫荧光、基因转染、免疫组织化学以及多种染色方法（Diff Quik、H&E、PAS），来评估这些方法的有效性和机制。体外实验结果表明，油酸能降低炎症细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-6和IL-1beta）的水平，分子对接研究提示油酸能与TLR3和TLR4蛋白相互作用形成配体-蛋白质复合物，显示出良好的结合亲和力。此外，油酸减弱了MAPK通路成分（JNK、p38 MAPK）和NF-kappaB通路成分（IkappaB、NF-kappaB、COX-2、PGE(2)）的表达。体内结果表明，油酸降低了炎症细胞（WBCs和嗜酸性粒细胞）水平和IgE活性，减少了Th2细胞转录因子GATA-3的表达，并降低了Th2/Th17相关细胞因子（IL-4、TNF-alpha和IL-6）的水平。油酸还减轻了OVA诱导的肺部病理变化，如上皮细胞增殖、炎症细胞浸润和黏液过度分泌。OVA通过调节Bcl-2和Bax的表达恢复了肺上皮细胞的凋亡。总之，油酸通过调节免疫细胞、发挥抗炎作用和促进凋亡，具有作为哮喘治疗新候选药物的潜力，从而改善哮喘表现。
